data.name: Serenity’s Call
data.passiveDescription: Upon causing an Elemental Reaction, increases Max HP by {{16//20//24//28//32%}} for 12s. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Max HP from this effect is further increased by {{16//20//24//28//32%}}. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
